newsitem.title: USA: Standard Motor seeks buyer for Service Line.
newsitem.headline: Standard Motor seeks buyer for Service Line.

text.p: Standard Motor Products Inc said Thursday it is seeking a buyer for its Service Line Division, a supplier of automotive accessories to car parts retailers.

Standard Motor chief executive officer Lawrence Sills said in a press release Service Line "does not fit the long-term strategy of the company." Standard Motor manufactures replacement parts for the automotive industry.
Standard Motor said it has contacted a number of potential buyers but has not cemented a deal. An asking price has not been disclosed.
Service Line's products include the Champ Service Line, APS Service Line and Pik-A-Nut. It had $43 million in sales in 1996, the company said.
